candidates.title: The Fish That Missed Every Meal
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the pond fish gathered for food long after the automatic feeder had stopped before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they filled the feeder again but it still released food at the wrong hour; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized its display used twelve-hour time and the feeding cycle had been set to midnight; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they corrected the clock setting and observed a safe daytime feeding, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Race That Never Reached the Finish
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the charity runners kept arriving at the same water station twice before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they painted larger finish arrows but the returning runners stayed confused; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the loop's turnaround point had been put beyond the crossing instead of before it; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they moved the checkpoint and had volunteers walk the full course before restarting, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Seed Swap With Missing Names
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered gardeners brought home seed packets belonging to entirely different families before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they sorted the packets by color but the owners were still mismatched; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the registration team had switched the detachable claim slips between neighboring trays; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they matched signed receipts to tray numbers and returned each packet to its owner, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
